# Mitigation Summary

## Action
Keep vol-0123456789abcdef0_2 at 3000 IOPS / 125 MiB/s. Add a write-latency guardrail alarm as the stop condition on FIS template EXTfpFLs9urWUme.

## Reasoning
The alarm was caused by planned FIS latency injection, not by running out of capacity. The workload keeps ~16 I/Os in flight, so at ~500 ms per I/O, IOPS falls to ~42 however much is provisioned. More IOPS would only add cost. What is missing is a stop condition: the template has stopConditions source=none. The guardrail fires at 1000 ms, twice the planned 500 ms, so future runs stop automatically if latency goes past what was planned. The plan passed the safe-deployment policy check.
